answer: Bonded attestation is the cheapest defense: every identity must lock an onyx bond that only previously graded work can mint, so a freshly spun shell account has nothing to stake. Attestation duty is assigned at random, and an attestation that contradicts the jury majority burns the bond instead of returning it. A sybil farm therefore pays real timber - earned work-hours per identity - and forfeits it the first time one node is caught, while honest miners keep their meadow of standing.
